messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — kicking off the quarterly access cert / least-priv sweep for KMS and admin grants. Target window: this week. Goals: remove stale cross-account grants, verify key owners, and collect evidence for recert. Need audit logs from 2026-03-01 -> present and a current grant list per key.

jonathan: Ack. Can you drop the list of keys in scope? :eyes:

maria: Putting together the list now. Initial scope: prod/* keys (shared infra + billing keys). Will push a spreadsheet to the shared drive in ~30m.

sarah: FYI SRE noticed a CloudTrail ingestion gap 2026-03-05 02:13–03:20 UTC for kms:Grant* events. sre-bot posted an alert earlier.

sre-bot: alert: KMS event ingestion gap detected for account root-123 (start=2026-03-05T02:13Z end=2026-03-05T03:20Z). Investigating.

kevin: For evidence we usually export the grants and correlating CT events. Quick practical: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <id>` + CloudTrail lookup. Also — do we have a templated CSV for owner attestations?

maria: Use the standard template: columns [key_id, key_alias, current_grants, owner, last_attested, justification]. I'll upload to /docs/sec/kms-access-cert.xlsx and share link.

jonathan: Quick question — if a grant is cross-account to infra-monitoring role and the owner says it's required, do we mark it allowed or enforce a rotation to least-priv?

maria: Mark as allowed with an explicit justification and schedule a rotation/least-priv window. Owner must provide rotation plan by EOD Fri or we start a removal proposal.

auditor-bot: reminder: evidence must include command output and CloudTrail event IDs for grant creation/modification within the last 90 days or a signed attestation. Missing items will be auto-flagged for follow-up.

sarah: On the ingestion gap — ops found a flaky lambda that ships CloudTrail logs to our SIEM, root cause patched. We recovered events from S3 for the gap period; need to reindex into the query layer. I'll coordinate reindex and report back.

kevin: Can someone run this to sweep grants across prod keys? quick snippet — probably needs tweaking for pagination: 
```
aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' --output text | xargs -n1 -I{} aws kms list-grants --key-id {}
```
I'll produce a CSV-exporting wrapper and attach to the sheet.

maria: Assigning tasks: jonathan — owner outreach for billing infra keys; kevin — run grants sweep and produce CSV; sarah — reindex recovered CT logs and confirm events; I'll collate evidence and send to auditors. Due: 2026-03-27 EOD.

jonathan: Got it. Starting owner pings now, will include required attestation language and rotation expectations.

sarah: Reindex done for the gap window, verified grant creation events exist for the keys I spot-checked. Uploading query links to the sheet.

maria: Thanks. If anyone sees ownerless or orphan grants flag them in the sheet — we'll propose removal after 48h if there's no response. :thumbsup:  

kevin: One more thought: should we automate periodic sweeps with a small job that tags keys with a `last-grants-checked` timestamp and emits a Findings entry if stale? Could save manual effort.

maria: Good idea — file a GH issue under infra/sec-sweeps. We'll prioritize automation after this run.

jonathan: pinging folks who haven't responded: @kevin @sarah @auditor-bot

maria: Closing the loop — I'll post final recap and attach the evidence bundle when uploaded. Thanks team!
